mapper.select: SELECT * FROM resource_publication_state WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND source_service=#{service} AND scope_key_hash=#{scopeHash} AND delete_flag=0
mapper.update: INSERT INTO resource_publication_state(tenant_id,source_service,scope_key,scope_key_hash,max_generation) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{service},#{scopeKey},#{scopeHash},#{generation}) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,source_service,scope_key_hash) WHERE delete_flag=0 DO UPDATE SET max_generation=GREATEST(resource_publication_state.max_generation,EXCLUDED.max_generation),updated_at=now() WHERE resource_publication_state.last_full_generation IS NULL OR resource_publication_state.last_full_generation < EXCLUDED.max_generation

INSERT INTO resource_publication_state(tenant_id,source_service,scope_key,scope_key_hash, max_generation,last_full_generation,last_full_payload_hash,last_full_status) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{service},#{scopeKey},#{scopeHash},#{generation},#{generation},#{payloadHash},#{status}) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,source_service,scope_key_hash) WHERE delete_flag=0 DO UPDATE SET max_generation=EXCLUDED.max_generation,last_full_generation=EXCLUDED.last_full_generation, last_full_payload_hash=EXCLUDED.last_full_payload_hash,last_full_status=EXCLUDED.last_full_status,updated_at=now() WHERE EXCLUDED.max_generation > resource_publication_state.max_generation OR (EXCLUDED.max_generation=resource_publication_state.max_generation AND EXCLUDED.last_full_generation=resource_publication_state.last_full_generation AND EXCLUDED.last_full_payload_hash=resource_publication_state.last_full_payload_hash)
